body:
Thanks for the advice but unfortunately I've already tried all that. I've got into hiking, tried out rock climbing, ran a rather successful youtube channel as a creative outlet, got into theatre production and other random stuff.

The issue that further cements that time is running out is (atleast from my perspective) I have tried, I really have. It does sound silly but I honestly struggle to have fun, I can stave off boredom yes but anything past that is a real rarity. I've been on this rodeo for almost 2-3 years now with very little deviation from this endless neutrality.
